name: DisconnectReconnectScheduler
tagline: Schedule every disconnect and reconnect within the rules – moratoriums, medical holds and SLAs built in.
description: A complete disconnect / reconnect operations app for electric, gas and water utilities: an eligibility check before every non-pay disconnect (arrears, notice period, medical certificates, life support, payment arrangements, winter moratorium, holidays and weekdays), remote AMI commands or field dispatch with results, payments that cancel orders or trigger reconnection, reconnect SLA tracking and fees. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Demo mode with fictional utility data
Winter moratorium, holidays and allowed weekdays
Remote AMI disconnect / reconnect or field dispatch
Field results incl. paid on site and no access
Reconnect SLA countdown and breach flags
Bulk schedule, dispatch, hold, route list
Customer notice, crew route, CSV and summary JSON outputs
controlType: standard (2 controls: DisconnectReconnectScheduler data-set + DisconnectReconnectSchedulerPortal field)
